And then I shared another idea on the dodge when the price line of dodge completed another bullish reversal bad move on the small time period 4 hour chart in the chart it was completing the final leg of this bullish reversal move. Before that it completed this harmonic bat move turned bullish from the potential reversals on then completed another garlic move on this on the four-hour chart then turned bullish and while this move the price line was completing another bullish reversal harmonic bat move and we also had a very good support of 50 simple moving average in the potential reversal zone and after playing the start we can see that the price line entered in this potential reversal zone and using this 50 simple moving every support also turned bullish and now it is moving down and in the meanwhile uh with the bitcoin pair the dodge first formed this head and shoulder pattern on this small time period for our chart and then broke down this neckline and also broke down this uptrend line as well and completed this bullish gardling move again on the daily time frame chart and in my previous videos i have been telling you that we needed the breakdown of exponential moving average 10 on the daily time frame chart and we also needed this trend line to be broken down and this neckline as well for the completion of this gardening move. And we also have another very good support of this 50 simple moving average you can see moving up just below this potential reversals on and in the meanwhile the price line of dodge is also completing another bullish reversal garden move with the bitcoin pair as well like you can see that after this bullish move the price line retraced between 0.618 to 0.786 fibonacci retracement level then projected between 0 point 382 to 0.886 here i have ignored some extra spikes because all the other legs are driven as required the bullish garland move now we need the final retracement between point 618 to 0.786 fibonacci retracement level and for that we need the breakdown of this EMA 10 on the daily time frame chart you can see that the price line is trying to break down at this time the EMA 10 on the daily time frame chart otherwise it can be reversed from here therefore this move can be conditional if this EMA 21 will be broken down then we can be confirmed that the price line will be entered in this potential reversal zone like previously we were expecting that if the ema 10 on the daily time frame chart will be broken down then this move will be confirmed and we can place over buying orders within this potential reversal zone same as like that i'm expecting if this EMA21 on the daily time frame chart will be broken down, then the price line can complete this move on the daily time frame chart with the US dollar pair. Previously, we were looking at the DOS with Bitcoin pair, and here I am showing you the DOS with US dollar pair, and if we switch to the small time period chart, then we can see that the price line of DOS withs dollar pair and if we switch to the small time period chart then we can see that the price line of dodge with u.s dollar pair is moving in this down channel and hitting the support and resistance very well at this time it is rejected by the resistance and we now we have this 100 simple moving average support on the four-hour time frame chart so if this 100 simple moving average support on the 4-hour time frame chart So if this 100 simple moving average support will be broken down on the 4-hour time frame chart there will be another confirmation that the priceline is going to complete this final lag of the guardley and then After entering in this potential reversal zone it can be turned bullish from here and as per the fibonacci sequence of the gardley uh the price line can realistically move between 0.382 to 0.786 fibonacci projection of a to d leg however it can even turn more bullish if it will cross up this 0.786 fibonacci projection level i've shared all these targets here at the patreon and i've also shared the link in the video's description to join me at the patreon you can find there now if the price line will break down this 100 simple moving average channel then while moving within this support and the resistance of the channel slowly slowly the price action can complete this final move and it it can enter in this potential reversal zone so uh in you can do your own research as well so this was the update so far i hope that you liked the video then do hit the like and do subscribe to the channel as well take care goodbye
